::: {.callout-note}
## Placeholder — not a finished chapter
A 1990 ECPM manual is now independently cited. This page still does not write the ECPM narrative (Issue #4). It does not treat ECPM as a proven formal predecessor of CSIL.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can define ECPM from recovered manuals and contemporaneous records, and can test later claims that ECPM sits between Creekview and individualized CSIL funding.

## Evidence status

- **Bibliographically confirmed (copy sought):** [ECPM *Skill Development Manual*](../sources/wanted-ecpm-manuals.qmd) (BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, 1990; five modules; 52 pages plus appendices), cited in the [Roeher / Salisbury bibliography](../sources/1990s-roeher-if-bibliography.qmd).
- **Later attributions (not contemporaneous instruments):** [IFRC Our Team](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) and [Gauthier 2014](../sources/2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd) treat ECPM as a named pre-CSIL project.
- **Not confirmed:** [*Keys on Freedom*](../sources/wanted-keys-on-freedom.qmd) (title/author/year still commissioning-issue only); a 1994 ECPM training revision. [Van der Klift 1994](../sources/1994-van-der-klift-hell-bent.qmd) is a different publication.
- **VCH:** current [CSIL service page](../sources/vch-csil-service-page.qmd) does not use the ECPM name.
- **Open questions:** editions versus conflicting citations (1990 vs 1994); whether ECPM is a formal predecessor or a reconstruction from later accounts.
